title: Beyond functional programming: a taste of Verse. Simon Peyton Jones & Tim Sweeney | Lambda Days 2023
summary: A Lambda Days keynote by Simon Peyton Jones and Tim Sweeney introducing Verse, Epic's functional logic language for the metaverse. It covers existential variables, unification and expressions yielding multiple values.
why: HN recommends it as an interesting look at functional logic programming with wide implications for game programming.

quote.text: the Verse project from Unreal is extremely interesting imo, and has much wider scope/implications.
